definitions: To have a great burden of responsibility or worry.
To feel overwhelmed by problems or duties.
examples: After the company went bankrupt, he felt the weight of the world on his shoulders.
She walked around with the weight of the world on her shoulders after her father passed away.
Don't take on too much; you'll end up with the weight of the world on your shoulders.
lemma: the weight of the world on one's shoulders
synonyms: have a lot on one's plate
source: the weight of the world on one's shoulders
